017package org.apache.juneau.http.response;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.http.*;
022
023/**
024 * Represents an <c>HTTP 102 Processing</c> response.
025 *
026 * <p>
027 * A WebDAV request may contain many sub-requests involving file operations, requiring a long time to complete the request.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * <b>Beta — API subject to change:</b> This type is part of the next-generation REST client and HTTP stack.
031 * It is not API-frozen: binary- and source-incompatible changes may appear in the <b>next major</b> Juneau release
032 * (and possibly earlier).
033 *
034 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
035 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/NextGenRestClient">juneau-ng REST client</a>
036 * </ul>
037 *
038 * @since 9.2.1
039 */
040public class Processing extends BasicHttpResponse<Processing> {
041
042   /** HTTP status code */
043   public static final int STATUS_CODE = 102;
044
045   /** Reason phrase */
046   public static final String REASON_PHRASE = "Processing";
047
048   /** Default status line */
049   private static final HttpStatusLine STATUS_LINE = HttpStatusLineBean.of(STATUS_CODE, REASON_PHRASE);
050
051   /** Default unmodifiable instance */
052   public static final Processing INSTANCE = new Processing().unmodifiable();
053
054   /**
055    * Constructor.
056    */
057   public Processing() {
058      super(STATUS_LINE);
059   }
060
061   /**
062    * Constructor with a response body.
063    *
064    * @param body The response body. May be <jk>null</jk>.
065    */
066   public Processing(HttpBody body) {
067      super(STATUS_LINE, body);
068   }
069
070   /**
071    * Constructor with a plain-text string body.
072    *
073    * @param body The response body as a plain-text string. May be <jk>null</jk>.
074    */
075   public Processing(String body) {
076      super(STATUS_LINE, body);
077   }
078
079   /**
080    * Copy constructor.
081    *
082    * @param copyFrom The bean to copy from. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
083    */
084   public Processing(Processing copyFrom) {
085      super(copyFrom);
086   }
087
088   @Override /* Overridden from BasicHttpResponse */
089   public Processing unmodifiable() {
090      return this instanceof UnmodifiableBean ? this : new Unmodifiable(this);
091   }
092
093   /**
094    * Unmodifiable point-in-time snapshot of the enclosing {@link Processing} response.
095    *
096    * <p>
097    * Its only behavioral override is {@link #modify(Runnable)}, which throws — because all mutation is funneled through
098    * {@code modify(...)}, this single override freezes the entire mutation surface.
099    */
100   public static class Unmodifiable extends Processing implements UnmodifiableBean {
101
102      /**
103       * Constructor.
104       *
105       * @param copyFrom The response to snapshot.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
106       */
107      @SuppressWarnings({
108         "java:S1699" // Paradigm intentionally calls the overridable freeze() from the ctor to deep-freeze sub-beans.
109      })
110      protected Unmodifiable(Processing copyFrom) {
111         super(copyFrom);
112         freeze();
113      }
114
115      @Override /* Overridden from BasicHttpResponse */
116      protected Processing modify(Runnable mutation) {
117         throw uoex("Bean is unmodifiable.");
118      }
119   }
120}
